rules.description: Do not create 'via' pages from keyword bridges.
rules.reason: Algorithmic page soup. 'via' pages are generated from keyword combinations and are not real brand/lore concepts.

rules.description: Do not create pages for generic words unless they are official project concepts.
rules.exception: Only allowed as part of an official named concept (e.g. 'bitcoin-kids', 'bitcoin-btc', 'nbg-token').
rules.reason: Generic words with no brand anchor are not useful wiki entries.

rules.description: Different brand concept types must remain as separate canonical pages.
examples: GraffPUNKS faction != GraffPUNKS radio != GraffPUNKS NFT collection != MidevilPunks game
HODL Warriors faction != HODL Wars game
rules.reason: Cross-concept pages conflate distinct brand identities.

rules.description: Pages must have at least 250 meaningful words.
rules.reason: Thin pages with little content do not serve readers and inflate the index.

rules.description: Pages tagged NEEDS_BRAND_REVIEW must not be published.
rules.reason: Unclassified pages may be duplicates or synthetic content.
